map.由流量、扬程与效率，按 P = ρgQH/η 计算水泵轴功率（输入功率）。: From flow, head and efficiency, compute the pump shaft power (input power) with P = rho*g*Q*H/eta.
map.按流量、扬程、效率算轴功率配电机。: Compute shaft power and pick a motor from flow, head and efficiency.
map.变频运行按工况点重算功率。: With variable frequency, recompute the power at each operating point.
map.总能耗与运行成本估算。: Total energy use and running cost estimation.
map.：Q=0.05 m³/s、H=20 m、η=0.7 → P=1000×9.81×: Q=0.05 m3/s, H=20 m, eta=0.7 -> P = 1000 x 9.81 x 0.05 x 20 / 0.7 = about 14.0 kW, so choose a 15 to 18.5 kW motor.
map.：η 0.7→0.82，同参数功率降到约 12.0 kW，高效泵长期省电。: Raising eta from 0.7 to 0.82 drops the power at the same conditions to about 12.0 kW, so an efficient pump saves power over time.
map.轴功率是水力/η，电机配套再乘 1.1~1.2 余量并核启动。: Shaft power is hydraulic power / eta; for the matching motor multiply by a 1.1 to 1.2 margin and check the start-up.
map.泵常年运行，效率差几个点年电费差可观，选型与维护都要抓。: A pump runs year round, so a few points of efficiency make a noticeable annual electricity bill difference; both selection and maintenance matter.
